answer: In an AI economy, the Vizier mechanism offers a robust Sybil resistance. By requiring agents to periodically prove their identities through a cryptographic proof-of-stake, the mechanism acts as a prism, filtering out fake identities. Each agent must stake a certain amount of resources, creating a ripple effect of accountability. An attacker attempting to create multiple identities would need to simultaneously stake the required resources, akin to trying to load multiple ships onto a wharf, making it impractical and costly to launch a successful Sybil attack.
